description: Upstream BerriAI/lens commit (upstream.env) and the workflow's actions. Merging a LENS_COMMIT bump rebuilds and pushes ghcr.io/2stacks/lens; the stack that uses it gets its PR in its own repo. Lens is pre-release and pairs with LiteLLM: read the compare link and check compatibility with the running LiteLLM and ClickHouse before merging.

packageRules.description: Upstream commit bumps wait for a Dependency Dashboard tick: Lens main moves daily and every bump needs a compatibility review
Major version bumps need a tick on the Dependency Dashboard first
